name: Lisie Hospital
summary: Lisie Hospital is a charitable multispeciality hospital in Kochi, founded in 1956. It has been accredited by NABH since November 2017 and houses the Lisie Heart Institute, set up in 2002.
highlights: Founded in 1956 as a charitable institution
Lisie Heart Institute, set up in 2002
Departments include cardiology, neurosurgery, nephrology and radiation oncology
